From e801038a02ce1e8c652a0b668dd233a4ee48aeb7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2024 04:39:29 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] clk: qcom: dispcc-sm8450: fix DisplayPort clocks

On SM8450 DisplayPort link clocks use frequency tables inherited from
the vendor kernel, it is not applicable in the upstream kernel. Drop
frequency tables and use clk_byte2_ops for those clocks.

This fixes frequency selection in the OPP core (which otherwise attempts
to use invalid 810 KHz as DP link rate), also fixing the following
message:
msm-dp-display ae90000.displayport-controller: _opp_config_clk_single: failed to set clock rate: -22

Fixes: 16fb89f92ec4 ("clk: qcom: Add support for Display Clock Controller on SM8450")
Reviewed-by: Neil Armstrong <neil.armstrong@linaro.org>
Reviewed-by: Konrad Dybcio <konrad.dybcio@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240424-dispcc-dp-clocks-v2-1-b44038f3fa96@linaro.org
Signed-off-by: Bjorn Andersson <andersson@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/clk/qcom/dispcc-sm8450.c b/drivers/clk/qcom/dispcc-sm8450.c
index 92e9c4e7b13d..49bb4f58c391 100644
--- a/drivers/clk/qcom/dispcc-sm8450.c

-	{ }

2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/clk/qcom/dispcc-sm8450.c`**
1. **Removed Frequency Tables**: The frequency table `ftbl_disp_cc_mdss_dptx0_link_clk_src` was completely removed. This table contained frequency entries for DisplayPort link clocks.
2. **Updated Clock Operations**: The clock operations for several clock sources (`disp_cc_mdss_dptx0_link_clk_src`, `disp_cc_mdss_dptx1_link_clk_src`, `disp_cc_mdss_dptx2_link_clk_src`, and `disp_cc_mdss_dptx3_link_clk_src`) were changed from `clk_rcg2_ops` to `clk_byte2_ops`.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The removal of the frequency tables is directly related to the change in clock operations. By eliminating the frequency tables that were inherited from the vendor kernel, the patch ensures that the DisplayPort clocks use the appropriate operations (`clk_byte2_ops`) that are suitable for the upstream kernel. This change addresses the issue of invalid frequency selection in the OPP core, which was causing errors in setting the clock rate for the DisplayPort link. The modifications collectively aim to fix the clock configuration for DisplayPort on the SM8450 platform, ensuring proper functionality and compatibility with the upstream kernel.
